newsitem.title: GERMANY: BMW shares up on six-month results.
newsitem.headline: BMW shares up on six-month results.

text.p: Shares in German carmaker BMW AG rose in pre-bourse electronic dealings on Tuesday, bolstered by higher sales and profits in six-month results.
BMW shares were up 12.50 marks at 1,482.50 marks while the 30-share DAX index was down 6.02 points at 4,394.28 points in IBIS computer dealings. Trading in its shares was thin, however.
The Munich-based carmaker earlier on Tuesday said group net profit for the period from January to June was up 30 percent to 435 million marks while sales were up 16 percent at 29.1 billion marks.
BMW also predicted higher sales, volume sales, profit and output for the full year.
